create_StandardScaler: create a StandardScaler to standardize features by removing the mean and scaling to unit variance
build_MinMaxScaler: build a MinMaxScaler to transform features by scaling each feature to a given range
run_QuantileTransformer: run a QuantileTransformer to transform features using quantiles information into uniform or normal distribution
test_PowerTransformer: test a PowerTransformer to apply Box-Cox or Yeo-Johnson power transforms to make data more Gaussian-like
refactor_RobustScaler: refactor a RobustScaler to scale features using median and interquartile range robust to outliers
